_note: MEASURED LIVE on the probe host the rest of the page-settings family uses
(`probe.html?case=pages-settings-seo`), and the guard is FIRED, not faked:
focus the meta-title field, type one character, click the Social tab. The
modal that appears is the drawer's own.
WHAT THE BOARD WON:
modal width  440 (1171:4820 is a 440x117 frame), via `size="question"`. It
was `size="lg"` = 720, which made a two-line confirm wider
than the Brand review dialog that lists every staged token
change. boards.json's "modal is 720w vs board 440" — fixed.
title size   13px (1171:4821). It measured 14 — see the finding below.
body leading `normal` (1171:4822); it was `leading-4`.
boards.json's other half — "buttons 40h vs 27" — no longer reproduces: both
buttons are `px-3 py-[7px]` with `min-h-0` and an 11px label, which is
1171:4825's 12/7 exactly, and both were measured passing.
FOUND AND FIXED, second sighting today: a caller CANNOT set a ModalTitle's
font size through `className`. `MODAL_TITLE_CLASS` is
`text-[length:var(--bk-text-14)]`; a caller's is a second arbitrary font-size
utility on a plain <h2>, and two classes on one property resolve by
STYLESHEET order — so `tw:text-[13px]` did nothing and the heading measured
14. The size now lives on a span, which is what the recipe anchors. The
identical defect is recorded in surfaces/brand-review-changes.json. TWO
callers is a component problem: ModalTitle wants a `size` prop, the way it
already has `inset` for the same class of collision — and this file needed
`inset={false}` too, because ModalBody's own 16px inset plus ModalTitle's
default pl-5/pt-4 is exactly the double-inset that prop exists to prevent.
NOT JOINED — 1171:4820, the dialog frame. Its `--color/bg-elevated` fill,
`--color/border` edge and radius 12 belong to `ModalContent`, a shared
primitive; and its `px-16 / py-14 / gap-10` describe the padded BODY, which
is `ModalBody` — a different element. Same skip, same reasons, as
brand-review-changes.
ONE UNKNOWN: 1171:4822's `width: min-content`. Figma exports a hug as a
keyword the length normaliser cannot read, and the live paragraph is a block
in a 440 dialog. Its 11px size and `--color/ink-soft` colour both pass.
CONTRAST SCOPE, deliberately the modal and not `body`: this dialog PORTALS to
the overlay root, so `body` sweeps the SEO tab behind it as well and reported
nine failures that belong to s3-flows-page-settings-seo, not here — `+30 pts`
and `Required` at `--bk-ink-muted` on `--bk-bg-subtle` (4.39:1, the systemic
pair), the yellow SEO-score banner at 3.41:1, and the `32/60` counter in
`--bk-success` on white at 3.39:1. Not mine to fix; recorded so the SEO
board's owner has them.
